title: Button-Eyed Chicken Oracle
description: A large black rooster with a red comb and wide green eyes sits atop a massive pile of colorful buttons on a cracked green table. It holds a voodoo doll with button eyes and a purple snake coils around its body and the table, set against a surreal night scene with a red sun, green moon, industrial buildings, and decorative borders of swirls and paisleys.
prompt: A surreal dark scene featuring a large black rooster with a red comb and wide green eyes perched on a huge pile of multicolored buttons on a cracked green stone table. The rooster holds a creepy voodoo doll with button eyes on a stick in one claw, while a long purple snake with a green head coils around its body and the table. In the background, a glowing green moon and a bright red sun hang in a cloudy sky above dark industrial buildings with smokestacks. The entire composition is framed by ornate swirling paisley and silhouette borders in vibrant colors.
